start is planned occurrence. created is initial appointment creation, not the time a booking was accepted or a status history. Keep these milestones distinct.

hints.proposed_guidance_wording: Ask the local referral/navigation and scheduling stewards how recognition, referral issuance, appointment creation, planned occurrence and completed encounters are recorded. If FHIR R4 4.0.1 is available locally, ServiceRequest, Appointment and Encounter may describe some order, scheduling and encounter milestones. Order activation is not recognition; appointment creation is not booking acceptance; a planned appointment is not a completed encounter. Confirm local definitions, optional links, missingness, history and vendor support. Request only locally approved aggregate interval distributions and episode counts by service/site and reporting period within the current planning horizon. The local steward must retain person- or episode-level dates, identifiers and linkage records; do not transfer record-level outputs to the app. Review rare cells, overlapping strata and differencing risk; coarsen or suppress as needed. These summaries do not establish intervention effects.
privacy_limits: No identifiers, individual records, exact patient dates, EHR/payer APIs, uploads or data egress.

Steward performs any necessary episode linkage locally under existing authority; only locally approved aggregate distributions and counts may be requested, never person-level or episode-level outputs.

Month/quarter/site/service strata require local assessment of rare cells, overlap, differencing and re-identification; suppress/coarsen unsafe outputs, with no universal numerical small-cell threshold assumed.
No numerical small-cell threshold is invented here. No output is collected by this app.

hints.proposed_guidance_wording: Ask program operations and scheduling stewards for aggregate staffed usable capacity and available appointment or navigation slots by site/service and week or month within the current planning horizon. If FHIR R4 4.0.1 is available locally, Slot and Schedule may describe scheduling intervals and resource availability. Free slots are not staffed capacity, FTE, unique participants, catchment or wait-time metrics. Confirm staffing, workload units, shared resources, reserve blocks, overbooking, service coverage and vendor support locally; use an aggregate HR/roster summary only if FTE is needed.
